notes: Read SKILL.md (426 lines) in full; it is the only file. The skill is a read-only (Read, Grep, Glob) DNS security review: discovering BIND/Unbound/CoreDNS/cloud DNS configs, DNSSEC signing and validation, DoT/DoH, RPZ/protective DNS (CIS Control 9.2), and DNS tunnelling/exfiltration detection indicators, with a report template.

No commands, installs, credentials or network access; tunnelling-tool signatures (SKILL.md:259-271) are detection patterns, not instructions to tunnel. SKILL.md:379 advises verifying DS records by querying parent nameservers, which the user would do outside the declared tool set.

Some NIST SP 800-81 Rev 2 section-number mappings (e.g. SKILL.md:99, :106, :112, :359-365) could not be verified and may not match the publication's actual structure. SKILL.md:394 links ../../../schemas/finding.schema.json, used only when JSON output is requested.
